content.text: Good! Now let me check the date format and understand the data better:

input.sql: SELECT DISTINCT FLX_ANN_MOI FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS ORDER BY FLX_ANN_MOI DESC LIMIT 10

content.text: Perfect! The date format is YYYYMM, so January 2025 is 202501. Now let me query for the top three regions by reimbursement amount in January 2025:

input.sql:
SELECT 
    dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB,
    SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT + COALESCE(fr.FLT_REM_MNT, 0)) as total_reimbursed
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.BEN_RES_REG = dr.BEN_RES_REG
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501
  AND fr.BEN_RES_REG IS NOT NULL
  AND dr.BEN_RES_REG IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY total_reimbursed DESC
LIMIT 3

content.text: I see that "Inconnu" (Unknown) is included in the results. Let me exclude that as the requirement specifies leaving out beneficiaries with unknown region of residence:

input.sql:
SELECT 
    dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB,
    SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT + COALESCE(fr.FLT_REM_MNT, 0)) as total_reimbursed
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.BEN_RES_REG = dr.BEN_RES_REG
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501
  AND fr.BEN_RES_REG IS NOT NULL
  AND dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB != 'Inconnu'
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY total_reimbursed DESC
LIMIT 3

WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501
  AND fr.BEN_RES_REG IS NOT NULL
  AND dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB != 'Inconnu'
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY total_reimbursed DESC
